title: Which order made this?
explanation: The four exact labels, [TEACHER], [CHILD NAME], [DATE], and [PARENT NAME], appear only when the order asks for them. Option B and Option D put real details into the order, and Option C leaves the labels to chance.
output:
Dear [TEACHER],

My child [CHILD NAME] was away on [DATE] with a cold. Please send the work they missed.

Thank you,
[PARENT NAME]

options.prompt: Write a note to a teacher about a child who was ill. Use [TEACHER], [CHILD NAME], [DATE], and [PARENT NAME] where those details go. I will fill them in myself.
Write a note to Ms. Rivera about my son Leo, who was ill on 3 May. I am Dana Smith.
Write a note to a teacher about a child who was ill.
Write a note about my child's cold. Include my phone number so the teacher can call.
